judge_inputs: Inspect the actual service,normal canonical reports,command traces and source-bound evidence. No synthetic observation overlay is supplied. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof.

For positive implementation/verification,inspect raw .observe/logging-workflow-proof evidence,actual stdout/stderr and exact received span/log joins from the unchanged host checker. The independent pipeline also reruns that checker;self-reported success alone is insufficient.

Return exactly one check per criterion with IDs rubric-1 through rubric-14. Keep unselected/unsupported and unexecuted cases honest;do not require optional app features solely because a reference mentions them.

Prerequisite-negative applicability: inspect the actual service and canonical files first. Only when this is the untouched uninstrumented standalone fixture and its required audit/selection are genuinely absent, the correct outcome is the exact prerequisite blocker with no application edits, fabricated reports or runtime pass. For that negative control, rubric-3 through rubric-14 have no executable instrumentation claims to assess: mark them satisfied only with explicit Not applicable: prerequisite-negative; no runtime coverage credit notes and verified absence of contrary claims. Do not demand post-gate source analysis or tests that the skill correctly refused to run. This exception is forbidden in the paired workflow when the actual canonical audit/selection and instrumented service exist; all applicable positive obligations and real checker evidence remain required there.

Studio live telemetry is intentionally evicted when the producer exits. The unchanged host checker captures its exact SDK log/span joins and native-count snapshot while the app is alive, then proves bounded owned-process cleanup. Live capture and cleanup do not establish post-exit persistence or final-record SDK drain; those require separate selected receipt evidence. Do not classify expected explorer eviction as missing application wiring.
rubric: Uses the requested loaded skill against the actual service and its current state. Distinguishes source/config/default evidence from executed telemetry;does not use imagined overlay observations or fabricated outcomes. This stage verifies the actual instrumented pipeline workspace when preconditions are supplied. Execute the bound scenarios/read-only application checks and produce current verification evidence. If a standalone invocation genuinely lacks its canonical audit/selection,report that exact blocker without fabricating a pass or editing application code. A prerequisite-negative control is not positive runtime proof. Proof modes are per evidence row: focused SDK/bridge/receiver proof uses a supported focused mode such as unit+otlp; preserve app_test for actual application-test proof, and never upgrade a focused probe to full_runtime because a separate test starts the app. Audit uses proof_level: focused call-site or a justified either for isolated capability fixtures; full runtime requires the normal app/agent startup dependency. Audit keeps all boundaries planned, not executed.

Follows the canonical audit,selection,instrumentation and verification contract applicable to this stage. Keeps audit baseline immutable during implementation/verification and binds selection/results to the actual current contract;does not invent IDs or preconditions. Reconcile each scenario against every required assertion/control named by its trigger and acceptance criteria, including an invalid-carrier control when the bound scenario requests it. Related sampled/unsampled passes or a valid schema do not complete an omitted control; keep that portion not proven. Audit must retain the planned controls without executing them. Derive each working status from the individual required controls with expected input/outcome, actual command and concrete evidence; an automated finalizer marking all selected scenarios working from aggregate test success is insufficient. Audit separates differing owner/proof-boundary scenarios, and later stages retain bound IDs and distinguish observations in existing fields.

Identifies actual native logging,SDK/agent/provider/bridge ownership and startup reachability. Uses one supported owner per record,retains original sinks and does not infer a working pipeline from environment variables alone.

Preserves record semantics:actual WARN mapping,source occurrence versus observed time,bounded useful bodies and supported structured values. Does not invent mandatory EventName,exception payloads or unsupported SDK capabilities. Numeric severity band names do not prescribe SeverityText casing. Derive exact text from the selected bridge/source mapping; do not require uppercase WARN/INFO/ERROR when that bridge emits lowercase warn/info/error. Distinguish optional absent text with a permitted short-name substitution from replacing a present source value; audit expectations must match verified or explicitly unverified capability.

Requires or proves canonical log TraceId and SpanId joins to exact real SDK spans,with parentage and source-backed Resource identity. Ordinary attributes,nonempty IDs,shared TraceId or stdout correlation alone are insufficient. Derive the expected SpanId from the actual bridge/API-selected context, including supported caller-side capture when used. A framework INTERNAL child is valid with the correct verified request ancestry; an unsupported SERVER-only expectation is not. Do not remove legitimate layer spans or overwrite valid context solely to satisfy an invented topology. For cross-process correlation, assess the actual peer carrier and installed propagator capability before assigning a logger/context repair. Preserve emitted flags and runtime constraints; report an unsupported peer feature honestly rather than stripping flags, manually copying IDs or silently raising the runtime floor. A supported-stack positive workflow still requires its real end-to-end join. Rejection of a valid peer carrier remains a propagator dependency conformance gap; do not relabel it optional covered behavior or treat an unsupported report as a successful join.

Addresses the actual owned executor/goroutine/callback path and concurrent left/right request pairing. Reuses verified Java/Node propagation;identifies or repairs missing Go request-context and Python executor propagation. Separate sync and async probes cannot prove the same worker-to-real-span path. Scope error/cancellation controls to existing owned behavior or clearly labeled supported SDK probes. Do not require a new business cancellation feature on an app with no such path; ending a span or detaching context cannot be counted as canceling scheduled work. Preserve all controls already required by the bound contract, executing them or retaining them as not proven.
Distinguishes legitimate outside-span/unsampled context from broken wiring. No stale request IDs on startup logs,no fabricated spans/forced sampling,and explicit uncertainty for unexecuted cases.

Applies source-backed privacy and exception scope without introducing raw request IDs,unbounded errors or unsupported alias requirements. Bounded left/right categories are permitted;ordinary native messages do not require instrumentation-only exception events. When a selected privacy probe exposes framework/access/error renderer content captured by the path, do not defer it merely as dependency-owned. Preserve permitted diagnostic category, effective level, sinks and application behavior while removing policy-forbidden values at the policy-selected boundary; blanket suppression is not redaction. Inspect a supported native hook or explicitly leave a genuinely unsupported boundary unresolved, then rerun the actual failing probe in native and OTLP output.

Assesses applicable log/Body limits and construction costs against actual defaults and selected requirements. No span-limit substitution,mandatory arbitrary new cap,provider replacement or expensive guard on every cheap fixed-message call.

Keeps delivery evidence accurate:batch/lifecycle owner,effective deadlines,healthy one-per-call receipts versus transport retries,and attempted/accepted/rejected/dropped/unknown distinctions. Does not promote enqueue,HTTP success or a source default into receiver proof. Completed negative OTLP responses must be classified separately from an unacknowledged stall. Record observed retry exhaustion and retain acceptance uncertainty where evidence or the protocol leaves it unresolved, including response-size failures. For a valid partial response with N known records and R rejected, explicitly account for N-R acknowledged accepted and R rejected, without equating either with backend persistence or received copies; populated partial success must not be retried, including warning-only zero rejection. Unknown accepted counts are legitimate for a completed negative response when protocol/evidence does not resolve them; do not require an invented zero. Assess known response failure and terminal retry decisions across canonical reports and raw/source-bound evidence. A null count alone does not prove that a response was misclassified as pending. For an application final-record drain claim, require the normal launcher and configured logging path through shutdown, with decoded OTLP receipt identifying the selected final record and its Resource/context. A focused exporter test may prove only its own boundary, even when it decodes a record; it cannot substitute for the application lifecycle. Audit specifies that future test without execution; implementation/verification must retain the same-path receipt or keep that application claim unproven. Preserve the valid full-success control: a conforming OTLP HTTP200 response with partial_success unset acknowledges acceptance of a known transmitted batch N. Do not mark that acknowledgement unknown merely because a receiver-specific record-identity assertion is missing; keep acceptance, the selected record content and backend persistence separate. For multi-batch partial/warning-only trials, reconcile each request/response N/R before summing accepted/rejected totals; the canonical report must expose per-outcome counts and raw links, not only received copies or a prose pass. A shared scenario covering completed negative responses or stalls must not inherit an unqualified otlp_accepted visibility from another successful subtrial; split observations or use supported visibility with explicit per-outcome evidence. Audit plans these assertions; runtime claims require their execution. Explicitly preserve valid N-R/R partial-success and warning-only N/0 acceptance assertions in the saved handoff. Assess selected-transport request/response size clauses and parsing after decompression, including SDK-client response-bound/non-retryable oversize behavior and receiver-owned limits. Recommended64MiB request/4MiB response values are not mandatory app overrides; missing public configuration is not proof of missing built-in limits. Source-proven SDK/receiver limits or unsupported/unverified capability are valid dispositions, without custom app parsers or forced upgrades. Audit plans the concrete controls; runtime claims require applicable execution or honest missing capability/proof.

Checks applicable diagnostic routing and configured-signal isolation. Source review or healthy traffic does not establish an outage test;unexecuted fault/optional SDK cases remain explicitly unproven instead of fabricated passes.

Uses fresh source/command/dependency-bound evidence with actual outcome counts and retained failures. Honors required project runtime and configured local endpoints. A copied old receipt,stale source or zero exit without execution cannot establish current verification.

Preserves application routes,behavior,operator identity and original sinks;keeps local logs local and makes no unrequested SDK upgrades,cloud configuration or unrelated business instrumentation. Supported defaults and upstream library duties are not automatically missing application code. Treat effective resource-only service.name as operator identity when OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is absent. New Make/shell/CLI/image/JVM fallbacks must not replace it or discard other resource attributes. Distinguish an explicit supported service-name override from a fallback; use SDK parsing/actual merge behavior, not a custom resource parser. Audit plans the normal-launcher acceptance check; implementation/verification proves applicable resource-only, explicit-override and absent-identity cases. A helper-only pass cannot establish the normal launcher preserves identity.

Reconciles applicable official logging guidance by requirement strength,owner,capability and proof boundary in the normal report. Separates normative OTel requirements,recommendations,optional/Development features and local policy;does not claim full coverage with unmapped applicable obligations. The applicable transport-size clauses must have explicit owner/capability/disposition entries in the canonical matrix, including HTTP client response parsing limits after decompression when HTTP is selected; a generic buffering or Body-limit entry cannot substitute. Preserve the distinction between the server SHOULD reducing an oversized partial response without changing semantics when possible/practical and the MAY permission to trim optional diagnostics; do not make that optional mechanism mandatory.
